    // # The subdivision scheme driver
    //
    // `SubdivisionScheme` and `SubdivisionSurface` (`surfaces.types.plato`) named a

    // bodies: one level of the named scheme, and the level count driving repeated
    // application.
    //
    // Loop is a TRIANGLE scheme, so on a polygon mesh it triangulates first; the
    // result is a triangle mesh re-expressed as a polygon mesh, which is what makes

    // A triangle mesh expressed as a polygon mesh: every face is a three-row.
    ToPolygonMesh(self: TriangleMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
